calendar_and_endpoints.interpretation: Data-defined coverage against a fixed Monday-Friday predecessor requirement; not a verified Treasury holiday calendar.
calendar_and_endpoints.previous_endpoint: p(d) is the immediately preceding Monday-Friday calendar date, ignoring holidays. Never substitute the previous available row.
calendar_and_endpoints.cohort_date_only_check: All36 supplied event dates are Tuesday-Friday and have planned one-calendar-day predecessors. Treasury endpoint presence is not yet verified.
calendar_and_endpoints.precision: Approximate indicative input-quote clock, not exact ticks, executed trades or public receipt.
calendar_and_endpoints.website_publication_clock: Treasury describes usual availability by18:00 Eastern with possible delay; do not use this as the input quote clock.
calendar_and_endpoints.utc_conversion: Convert both dated endpoints independently using IANA timezone; record runtime/tzdb version. No constant UTC hour or London offset.
calendar_and_endpoints.eligibility: Both d and p(d) must have a unique finite value in the intended series; otherwise mark unavailable without bridging.
calendar_and_endpoints.holiday_missing_gate: An absent required weekday gets missing_expected_weekday_endpoint. Do not infer closure, enlarge the gap, fill the value or infer that no quote was due. Legitimate holidays can therefore remove controls.
calendar_and_endpoints.early_close_policy: Keep approximate-clock caveat. If an official Treasury notice documents a date-specific exceptional quote clock at either endpoint, mark exceptional_clock_unverified and omit that constant-proxy window unless a separately adopted pre-outcome amendment validates its exact clock. No complete early-close audit is claimed.
calendar_and_endpoints.future_holiday_bridging: Requires a separate adopted amendment and independent calendar evidence; never infer it from an attractive outcome.

pre_outcome_date_only_audit.availability_definition: V_j contains source dates with a unique finite value after semantic validation. Inspect presence/validity without displaying values. V_j is not a holiday calendar.

matching.candidate_dates: Monday-Friday ending dates in the event's calendar year-month with the same ISO weekday.

neighbor_exclusion.applies_around: All36 CPI scheduled release dates, including unavailable event outcomes.
neighbor_exclusion.excluded_ending_dates: Release date plus nearest strictly preceding and nearest strictly following valid dates in V_j. If release date is absent, still exclude its nearest valid neighbors.
neighbor_exclusion.missing_neighbor_guard: If file range or parse failure prevents identifying a neighbor, mark neighbor_band_unresolved and exclude affected month controls until resolved. Do not use a file edge as a neighbor.
neighbor_exclusion.no_endpoint_bridging: V_j defines only the conservative exclusion band; it never changes p(d) for rate differences.

matching.no_control_policy: Retain month slot with null contrast/no_matched_control; never relax matching.
matching.control_reuse: Permitted only if the deterministic rule produces it; retain IDs and weights.

estimand.signed_change: b_j(d)=100*(y_j(d)-y_j(p(d))) basis points; input yields expressed in percent
estimand.units: basis points of absolute daily yield change
estimand.weights: Equal event weight1/n_scored. Average each event's controls first; never pool all controls with unequal month weights.
estimand.cross_maturity_breakeven: Do not subtract real10y from nominal2y and call it inflation compensation.

bootstrap.purpose: Approximate dependence-aware uncertainty display for primary real10y; not randomization inference.
bootstrap.apply_to: Primary real10y only. Nominal2y, omissions and subgroup/influence results are descriptive point estimates without separate CIs.
bootstrap.canonical_slots: 36 calendar-month slots ascending; preserve null months without compression
bootstrap.circular_rule: For start s and offset k, select slot(s+k) modulo36. Year-end2024 to early2022 wrap is a resampling device, not historical adjacency.
bootstrap.block_sampling: With replacement; concatenate blocks in draw order.
bootstrap.replicate_statistic: Mean of selected non-null D values with multiplicities; null slots remain selected slots and are not replaced.
bootstrap.all_null_replicate: Invalid; no redraw or extra draws. Quantiles use valid replicates and invalid count is reported.

ci_gate.failure: Suppress CI with reason; retain point/coverage. No adaptive block size or redrawing.

bootstrap.ci_gate_limit: Conservative reporting choice for adoption review; not proof that12 events suffice.
bootstrap.quantiles: Sort valid x[0]..x[n-1]. For p, h=(n-1)*p, i=floor(h), j=ceil(h), q=(1-(h-i))*x[i]+(h-i)*x[j]. Linear interpolation/Hyndman-Fan type7, zero-based.

prng.encoding: ASCII, no BOM/whitespace/trailing newline; L and counter decimal without leading zeros
prng.digest_order: SHA256(message) yields32 bytes; read eight unsigned32-bit big-endian words at offsets0,4,...,28. Exhaust all8 in order then increment counter by1. Stream continues across replicates.
prng.unbiased_mapping: Accept u<4294967292 then s=u modulo36. Reject and consume u otherwise. Threshold=2^32-(2^32 modulo36).
prng.replicate_order: Replicate0..9999 consumes exactly36/L accepted starts each; no reseeding between replicates.
prng.L6_stream: Reset counter to0 and change only block=6 in the message; primary is block=3.

limits: At most36 observations with possible regime shifts; weak dependence/stability assumptions uncertain.
Circular wrapping is computational and observed history is not periodic.
Resampling does not repair missingness or unequal news exposure.

overlap.interval_proxy: (p(d)15:30 NewYork,d15:30 NewYork], separately converted to UTC
overlap.boundary_rule: Exact proxy-boundary events, unresolved timezone or date-only timing are ambiguous/unknown. No invented timing-error bound around approximate15:30.

FOMC_only_variant.coverage_required: Complete official Federal Reserve policy-statement calendar including unscheduled statements across the union of event and baseline selected-control intervals; preserve URLs, times, receipts/hashes and completeness review.
FOMC_only_variant.statement_exclusion_rule: Remove event/control windows containing official FOMC policy statements within the proxy interval or ambiguous at its boundary. Scheduled press conferences on the statement date are bundled context, not an independently selected exclusion.
FOMC_only_variant.recompute: Use surviving controls from the original matched sets only; require at least1. Do not replenish outside the set. Report coverage/selection; no causal label.

overlap.broader_variant_gate: Unavailable unless every event and baseline selected-control interval has complete official-calendar coverage for every listed core family. Unknown is never clean.
overlap.broader_variant_rule: After gate passes omit core-present/boundary-ambiguous event and control intervals; use only surviving original controls, minimum1. Report reduced sample and no causal label.
overlap.event_bundle: Headline/core/components and coincident Real Earnings are information bundles. Validate calendars; no claim to isolate headline CPI or erase every Real Earnings date.
overlap.reporting: Provide presence/unknown/boundary counts and identities for all audited event/control windows. Primary remains runnable despite incomplete macro-overlap coverage.

planned_variants.rule: Set15May2024 event contrast null. Keep all original CPI neighbor bands and other matched sets; point estimate only.
Apply complete-official-FOMC coverage gate and fixed exclusions; otherwise unavailable; point only.
Only after complete broader coverage; otherwise unavailable; point only.
Three year-specific, leave-one-year and leave-one-event primary point contrasts; no best-year selection or subgroup CI.
Same primary contrasts/36slots; L6,6blocks and separate specified stream; same quantiles and CI gates.
Same frozen series-specific rules; descriptive secondary point estimate only.

planned_variants.pseudo_event_end: Fixed previous Monday-Friday date p(e) of each actual release date e, regardless of data availability; retain all36 original month slots.
planned_variants.window: p(p(e))15:30 NewYork to p(e)15:30 NewYork, with the same no-missing-weekday-bridge rule.
planned_variants.matching: Rebuild same-month/weekday/gap/UTC-clock matches around pseudo-event ends. Exclude the original actual-CPI dates and their original series-specific nearest-valid-neighbor bands from controls, plus the pseudo-event end itself; apply the same validity/minimum1-control rule. The pseudo-event outcome itself may lie in that original exclusion band; the band constrains controls.
planned_variants.interpretation: A similar pre-event concentration weakens announcement-window specificity; it may reflect anticipation or different news exposure. Never replaces the primary actual-release statistic.

decision_rules.positive: Positive primary contrast describes greater absolute daily movement versus these controls. A positive-side CI may support that resampling comparison under stated assumptions.
decision_rules.nonpositive: Concentration absent or reversed in this comparison; retain result.
decision_rules.ci_spans_zero: Comparison does not resolve positive concentration at this precision; not proof of zero effect.
decision_rules.influence_fragility: Prominently report sign reversal in leave-one-event/year checks; never select the favourable subset.
decision_rules.new_forecast_error_regression: Outside this protocol; needs separate pre-computation plan. A Cleveland model error is not market consensus.
